name: Cline
tagline: An open-source coding agent for your editor and terminal that plans a change, then carries it out with your approval.
about: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent. In Plan mode it works out an approach; in Act mode it edits files and runs commands, asking before each step.
pros: Open source and free; you pay only your model provider.
Works with many model providers, including local models.
Asks for approval before editing files or running commands.
cons: Cost depends on the model and how much code it reads.
Needs your own API key or provider account.
